summary: TransAlta Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release regarding a U.S. Department of Energy order mandating its subsidiary's Centralia Unit 2 remain available for operation for an additional 90 days until September 13, 2026. This is a regulatory compliance matter, not a special situation. No financial terms, stakes, or structural changes are involved. The filing is a routine disclosure of an operational directive. Watch for any subsequent developments regarding plant operations, but no risk-arb angle exists.
